bodyRules: hips commit before the shoulder mass fully catches up
piston rods and forearm mass visibly finish force transfer
heels and anchor feet release late and settle last
hero impact reads as accumulated mass rather than a fast human punch
bastion.recoveryRule: pressure and linkage recoil are readable before the ready silhouette is recovered
bastion.fxSeparation: pressure vent, piston exhaust, bore trails and furnace flare are separate FX

bodyRules: digitigrade legs preload and release like mechanical springs
contact is abrupt with deliberate overshoot rather than smooth interpolation
braking poses are as important as launch poses
low body mass stays coherent even when blades or afterimages extend the attack read
viper.recoveryRule: hard brake and footing reacquisition must read before neutral is restored
viper.fxSeparation: blade arcs, electrical discharge, afterimages and brake sparks are separate FX

bodyRules: setup is measured and visibly anchored
the containment side remains asymmetrically dominant
ground anchors and broad support geometry communicate force management
active poses hold structural authority instead of becoming loose human martial-arts silhouettes
citadel.recoveryRule: anchors, shield mass and torso alignment reset deliberately before ready
citadel.fxSeparation: field rings, anchor shock, containment walls and pulse effects are separate FX

bodyRules: the physical body remains one coherent chassis in every cel
false positions never replace the canonical physical body drawing
narrow body geometry changes direction precisely rather than smearing
integrated lance and prism vanes preserve mechanically plausible hinges through all phases
mirage.recoveryRule: the physical chassis resolves first; optical false-vector collapse is separate FX
mirage.fxSeparation: optical echoes, null lines, phase seams and false-vector collapse are separate FX
